answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 50 slots; agents bid sealed deposits, and the 51st bid sets the clearing price. A plume of cheap fake bids only lifts the delta between the floor price and what every attacker pays. Winners lock the deposit for 20 epochs, like a cedar growing slowly. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 POA = 4,000 POA locked; one honest agent pays 40 POA once and earns it back from fees, so bulk forgery loses money.
